label: Blob
description: A whole body as one stored file. The bytes stream into the blob registry as they arrive and the value is the handle (id, contentType, size, filename); nothing of the file passes through the engine. Sending a blob streams its bytes back with its own content type, its length and, when it has a filename, a content-disposition attachment. Map any content type a route uploads or downloads whole to this codec: text/csv, application/pdf, application/octet-stream.
